To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we develop the approach to the dispersion relation in the Bethe Salpeter formalism and apply the developed approach for the construction of the separability kernel of the NN interaction.
we developed dispersion relations for NN T-matrix in Bethe-Salpeter equation for two spin 1/2 particles system.
we have developed a new method for the calculation of the nucleon-nucleron scattering amplitude.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the dispersion representation for NN-T-matrix and with the construction of the separability condition for the interaction kernel in the framework of the Bethe-Sapler equation.
the construction of separable NN-potential in the framework of the relativistic Bethe-Salpter equation for the two spin one-half particles system with the kernel of interaction.
the construction of the dispersion relations for the NN-T-matrix in the Bethe Salpeter approach and the calculation of low-energy parameters for the separable interaction in NN-scattering.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the present results show that the dispersion relation for the NN-scattering T-matrix is very well satisfied by the results of the separable Bethe-Salpter equation with the separable kernel.
the separable approximation to the kernel of the Bethe-Sapeter equation is a very useful and convenient tool for solving the NN-scattering problem in the framework of dispersion theory.
the present approach is a promising one for a systematic investigation of the NN-scattering in the framework of BS-equation with the separable kernel.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have obtained the NN-scattering amplitude and the deuteron binding in the framework of the Bethe-Sapler equations.
the separable kernel can be used for the construction of NN interaction in the framework of dispersion relation approach.
the developed approach allows to construct the separable kernel in NN-scattering with high accuracy for the low-energy parameters.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the separable kernel is a very good approximation for the NN interaction in the low energy region.
the developed method is very convenient for the calculation of NN-scattering and deuteron binding energy in the framework of the Bethe-Sapeter approach.
the dispersion representation of the T-matrix in a separable kernel model can be used as an alternative to the partial wave decomposition.
